answer: Ridge-anchor bond-decay bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and anchor it to one ridge plot. Each epoch it decays by 10 unless the holder files a fresh zephyr reading, key-signed. Faking 1,000 locks 70,000, bleeding 10,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files one reading and keeps its bond.
